propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated plan reviews whose relation graph walks that directory
Empty ticket directories created by incomplete writes persist invisibly in local clones because git cannot track empty directories, blocking review-plan on entire epics until manually removed
The plan-relation reducer should skip event-less directories with a warning rather than failing the snapshot, tolerating this store detritus without blocking unrelated ticket reviews

The writer-side creating ticket directories before their first event cannot be safely changed due to concurrency and cannot repair existing broken clones, so reader-side tolerance is the appropriate fix
